metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace: skills for technical writing, FPGA/ASIC design and Verilog/SystemVerilog coding.

plugins.name: docs-standards
plugins.description: Technical-documentation quality standards (for documents and for explanations given in chat), an audit workflow, the shape of a measurement or comparison report, PDF typesetting with section-reference and glyph checking, analysis reports of existing designs verified against real artefacts, research design documents with refutable hypotheses and a candidate sieve, and theses or R&D reports written from artefacts with a literature review protocol (writing-technical-docs + reporting-experiments + typesetting-documents-as-pdf + documenting-existing-designs + designing-research-studies + writing-research-reports skills, /review-doc command).

plugins.name: fpga-design
plugins.description: FPGA/ASIC digital-design discipline: synthesisable RTL patterns, mandatory timing constraints, and build verification (writing-synthesizable-rtl, constraining-fpga-designs, verifying-fpga-builds).

plugins.name: sunburst-hdl
plugins.description: Verilog/SystemVerilog discipline from Cliff Cummings' award-winning Sunburst Design papers: race-free coding and testbenches, async FIFOs, CDC, FSM styles, case-statement safety, SV processes/ports, designer SVA, simulation performance.
